newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Metro sells nine properties.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Metro sells nine properties.

text.p: Scottish Metropolitan Property Plc said on Monday it sold a portfolio of nine properties to Greenwich Group International on behalf of managed funds for 26.55 million stg cash.
The sale of the properties in Birmingham, Edinburgh and Glasgow produced a loss of 2.1 million stg on book value, the company said in a statement.

Scottish Metropolitan said its sales programme for the year to last Friday would realise over 40 million stg -- some 1.8 million stg below book value -- while acquisitions would amount to about 28 million stg. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
